groundTruth.description: The Favorites view must not recommend opening the Favorites view itself.

hypotheses.title: 'Favoritos' Page Displays Empty State Message with Unclear Call to Action
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The page title reads 'Favoritos' (Favorites) and displays a message: 'Seu coração ainda está leve. Toque no coração dos produtos que você quer guardar.' followed by an 'Explorar a vitrine' button. The text implies the user hasn't saved any favorites yet, but the call to action is vague ('Explore the storefront'). The '0 achados' label further reinforces this empty state.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: Given the page title 'Favoritos', users expect to see their saved items. If no items are saved, a more explicit message like 'You have no saved favorites' and a clear call to action (e.g., 'Start Saving Items') would be preferable. The current phrasing is confusing as it suggests the user *should* be tapping hearts on products but doesn’t explain how to get to that point or what happens after.
hypotheses.oracle: Browser Oracle: After clicking the 'Favoritos' link in the navigation, the page should either display saved favorites or a clear empty state message with an actionable prompt (e.g., button) to begin saving items. The 'Explorar a vitrine' button should redirect to the homepage/product listing page.

hypotheses.title: Inconsistent Icon Styling Between Navigation and Bottom Bar
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The 'Favoritos' icon in the top navigation bar is a filled heart, while the corresponding icon in the bottom navigation bar is an outlined heart. This creates visual inconsistency.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: Icons representing the same function (in this case, 'Favorites') should have consistent styling across all areas of the application.
hypotheses.oracle: Browser Oracle: After clicking the 'Favoritos' link in the top navigation bar, verify that the 'Favoritos' icon in the bottom navigation bar is also a filled heart.

hypotheses.title: Bottom Navigation Bar Text Overlap/Truncation Potential
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The text labels beneath the icons in the bottom navigation bar ('Início', 'Comidas', 'Favoritos', 'Pedidos', 'Perfil') appear very close to the edges of their respective icon containers. Depending on font size and screen resolution, there's a potential for these labels to overlap or be truncated.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: Text labels within UI elements should have sufficient padding to prevent truncation or overlap, ensuring readability across various screen sizes and resolutions.
hypotheses.oracle: Browser Oracle: Resize the browser window to its smallest width. Verify that all text labels in the bottom navigation bar remain fully visible and do not overlap with their corresponding icons.
